title: 4 Energy Quadrants
subtitle: You manage your calendar carefully but still feel drained and underperforming. You have
useWhen: the time but not the capacity. The problem is not scheduling, it is energy management. You are treating yourself like a machine that runs on hours rather than a human who runs on energy.
howToUse: Jim Loehr and Tony Schwartz, in The Power of Full Engagement, proposed that high performance depends on managing four types of energy: Physical (the foundation, sleep, movement, nutrition), Emotional (stability, resilience, positivity), Mental (focus, concentration, clear thinking), and Spiritual (meaning, purpose, alignment with values). Each type of energy has a capacity that can be built through stress and recovery cycles, like a muscle. Most high performers burn energy in all four dimensions without systematically recovering it, leading to diminishing performance over time despite increasing effort. The mistake most founders make is treating time as the scarce resource and energy as unlimited. It is the opposite. You can always find more hours, but energy that has not been recovered does not come back just because you willed it to. Managing your calendar without managing your energy is optimizing the wrong variable entirely.
steps: Audit your current energy management across all four dimensions before designing any new habits.
Physical energy is foundational, nothing else works well when it is depleted. Fix sleep first.
Identify your highest-energy time of day and protect it for your highest-cognitive work.
Build recovery rituals for each energy type, not just physical recovery. Manage your energy not just your time
origin: Jim Loehr & Tony Schwartz, The Power of Full Engagement, 2003
promptBody:
Act as a high-performance coach using the 4 Energy Quadrants framework.
My current situation:
Sleep (hours / quality): [X]
Exercise (frequency / type): [X]
Emotional state (how you typically feel at work): [X]
Focus (how well you concentrate for deep work): [X]
Sense of purpose (how aligned your work feels): [X]
Main energy drains: [WHAT DEPLETES YOU MOST]
Audit my energy across all four dimensions:
PHYSICAL     :  Current state, biggest gap, one recovery ritual
EMOTIONAL :  Current state, main drain, one stabiliser habit
MENTAL         :  Current state, focus blockers, one protection habit
SPIRITUAL     :  Current alignment, what drains meaning, one anchor
Design my Minimum Viable Energy Routine:
The smallest set of habits that would most improve my total energy capacity in 30 days.
Maximum 4 habits. Each under 20 minutes per day.

proTip:
The Minimum Viable Energy Routine is designed to be non-negotiable and sustainable
not impressive. Most high-performers have complex morning routines they follow for two
weeks and abandon. Four small, consistent habits performed daily for 90 days compound
into a meaningfully different baseline. Start with sleep, then add one habit at a time.
